description: This is the main React component for the Next.js frontend application, handling the user interface for uploading documents, managing persona data, and orchestrating backend interactions for persona generation, versioning, and editing.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown input into a string array, filtering out non-string or empty values.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Maps backend JSON data into the UI's PersonaData structure, with fallback for missing fields.

methods.name: handleFileChange
methods.description: Handles file input change event, validating and adding uploaded files.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Adds and validates new files to the upload list, respecting maximum file constraints.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Handles drag-and-drop file upload, invoking addFiles with dropped files.

methods.name: handleDragOver
methods.description: Prevents default behavior to allow drop events.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specific file from the uploaded files list.

methods.name: handleGenerateDraft
methods.description: Triggers backend orchestrations to generate a persona draft from uploaded documents.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Saves current persona data as a new version to the backend.

methods.name: handleFinalize
methods.description: Marks the current persona as finalized.

methods.name: refreshVersions
methods.description: Fetches and updates the persona version history from the backend.

methods.name: removeSkill
methods.description: Removes a specified skill from the persona's skill list.

methods.name: addSkill
methods.description: Adds a new skill to the persona's skill list.

methods.name: handleProfileImageChange
methods.description: Handles user profile image upload and updates persona data accordingly.

methods.name: removeExperience
methods.description: Removes an experience entry from the persona data.
